basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 16-year-old gamer from Kerala, India, currently in high school. I love playing Roblox, especially getting into cross-trading and exploring new game modes. When I'm not gaming, I'm often catching up on tech news or chilling with some dank memes. My typical online hours are evenings and weekends, mainly because school keeps me busy during the day. I'm single and focused on my studies and gaming for now.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been gaming since I was a kid, and Roblox is my current obsession. Most of what I know about cross-trading comes from watching YouTube tutorials and learning from other traders in the community. I also have a keen interest in technology, which I follow through subreddits and online articles.
